sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [Am]Far from the [C7]rapid pace where [F]God can [A7]soothe my [Dm]troubled [Em]mind.
[F]There in my [Dm]quiet hour with [Am]Him my [F#m]cares [B7]are [E]left be[Dm7]hind[G].
[Am]Or on a [C7]mountain tall, New [F]strength and [E7]courage [Am]there I [C7]find;
[Em7]I go pre[A7]pared to face a [Dm]new day With [G7]love for all man[C]kind.
